about.guidelines_note: 1) No official Egyptian FBDG was found. FAO's FBDG database has no Egypt page (the FAO country URL returned 404). The 2019 review of Eastern Mediterranean FBDGs (Montagnese et al., PMC6627223, Table 1) lists Egypt as 'No data available on FBDGs'. The Global Nutrition Report profile is inconsistent: it shows 'No' but adds a note about FBDGs in 2018. Searches in Arabic and English found no NNI food guide with serving numbers. The food groups above therefore come from the closest official reference: the WHO EMRO 2012 'Promoting a healthy diet for the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region: user-friendly guide', which was produced in Cairo. Sources are its Table 6.1 (pages 20-21), Box 6.2 for the meat, poultry and pulse frequencies, the section 10 title for fish, and the plate graphic for water (8 cups per day). Studies of Egyptian adults also use this WHO EMRO guide as the 'appropriate for Egypt' reference (PMC6106130). 2) Nutrition: USDA FDC SR Legacy values per 100 g as purchased, except molokhia_frozen and tea, which come from the Japanese MEXT tables. USDA's raw jute entry has no fiber value, and USDA has no dry black tea leaf entry. Rice: FDC 169760 (medium-grain, unenriched, close to Egyptian japonica rice) has no fiber value, so fiber comes from 168879 (same rice, enriched; enrichment changes iron, not fiber). 3) Units: oil and milk in meals are in ml (tbsp = 15 ml, cup = 240 ml). For grams use FDC 171025 (1 tbsp oil = 13.6 g) and FDC 171265 (1 cup milk = 244 g). 4) Meal amount
